method: Target set: functions in cataclysm_gog_r2 functions.csv absent from cataclysm_gog_r1 and still FUN_* (548; 543 create_functions_r2.json reason=pointer-table, 5 found by analysis), all still FUN_* in cataclysm_gog_r3a. Every dword equal to a target was located in raw cataclysm.exe .rdata/.data (and imm32 in .text); each reference was read with +-8 dwords of context annotated with r3a function/data/string names. C++ tables resolved through RTTI CompleteObjectLocators (vtable class + slot), slot meaning taken from Titan headers (gardens-of-kadesh original-release-snapshot/src/Titan) and from already-named sibling slots; game tables identified by their named members, string columns and the code that indexes them (call_graph/decompiled.c of r3a), then each body read in decompiled.c. HW1 names only where the table and body match HomeworldSDL. B1 (fix_bodies_r3.report.csv) created no uncovered-run functions, so mission-uncovered has no targets.
